payload.purpose_context: The #849 decisive test (graph memory vs vector-RAG vs full-corpus baselines over Kent's goal and outcome scenario arcs, run on office4 local inference) is blocked behind its preconditions mission, whose merge to main is held on the FR-015 pre-merge checker record. One required live check always fails because the runtime only knows the container-network service names. This mission lets the runtime accept explicit endpoints while keeping today's in-container defaults, so the checker can pass and the decisive run can start.
payload.purpose_tldr: Let the #849 pre-merge checker's required live test reach the FalkorDB and llama services from the host, so the decisive Life Lattice test can proceed.
